name: CSX
description: CSX is an eastern-US Class I freight railroad. Its railroad subsidiary, CSXT, hauls chemicals, farm goods, autos, minerals, metals and forest products (merchandise), containers and trailers (intermodal) and coal, and customers pay a per-shipment rate plus fuel surcharges. A bulk-liquid trucking subsidiary (Quality Carriers) and regional subsidiary railroads add smaller revenue. The business is a single rail segment, so profit is not split by line; consolidated operating margin was 32.1 percent in FY2025.

businessLines.name: Merchandise
businessLines.how: Shippers pay a per-carload rate (about $3,382 per unit in FY2025) to move chemicals, agriculture and food, autos, minerals, forest products, metals and equipment and fertilizers over the CSXT network, plus fuel recovery charges.

businessLines.name: Intermodal
businessLines.how: Per-container rate for hauling domestic and international containers and trailers on rail between terminals east of the Mississippi (about $692 per unit); much lower revenue per unit than carload freight.

businessLines.name: Coal
businessLines.how: Per-carload rate to move domestic coal, coke and iron ore to power plants and steelmakers and export coal to ports; export revenue moves with global benchmark prices (line revenue fell 15% in FY2025).

businessLines.name: Trucking
businessLines.how: Quality Carriers charges customers for bulk liquid chemical truckload shipments; a non-rail subsidiary.

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Revenue from regional subsidiary railroads plus incidental charges: intermodal storage, equipment usage, demurrage (cars held too long) and switching.

brands.name: CSX Transportation (CSXT)
brands.note: Railroad operating subsidiary, approximately 20,000 route miles

brands.name: Quality Carriers
brands.note: Largest provider of bulk liquid chemicals trucking; the trucking line, $816M, 6% of FY2025 revenue

whatsNext.text: Union Pacific / Norfolk Southern merger agreement (2025) awaits Surface Transportation Board approval; it would form a transcontinental network adjacent to CSX territory
whatsNext.note: No decision date is stated in the CSX filings read.
